description: Read a game's live ops: `now` (what players see right now: the merged config plus active and upcoming events), the base config, every scheduled event with its status (active / upcoming / ended), the highlight webhook (masked) and the 20 latest highlights with how each was delivered. Pass `at` to preview another instant (e.g. the middle of a weekend event) and `room` to see one room's view. Use it to verify every change you make.

game.description: Which game to act on: its publishable key (pk_…) or its exact name. Defaults to the x-mp-game header, then your primary game.

room.description: Resolve for this room (events limited to other rooms drop out). Default: game-wide.

name: get_live_ops
title: Get a game's live ops
